    • boardView

      public HashMap<javafx.util.Pair<Integer,Integer>,Float> boardView

      boardView

      Represent all cases on the board (even with a symbol) Each position (Pairinvalid input: '<'Integer, Integer>) get a value depending of the possible move on it : - If the case is occupied by the symbol of the Bot the value is equal to 0 - If the case is occupied by the symbol of the Adverser the value is equal to -1 - Before calculation / When initialised, every case equal 1 - If it is different from -1, 0 ot 1 then it is the value of the case for the bot
